{"path":"/work/tests/test_priority.py","content":"import json

import pytest

from todo.api import create_task, list_tasks, update_task
from todo.store import Store


def test_default_priority(tmp_path):
    s = Store(str(tmp_path / "s.json"))
    t = create_task(s, {"title": "a"})
    assert t["priority"] == "normal"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("p", ["low", "normal", "high"])
def test_create_with_priority(tmp_path, p):
    s = Store(str(tmp_path / "s.json"))
    t = create_task(s, {"title": "a", "priority": p})
    assert t["priority"] == p


def test_create_unknown_priority_rejected(tmp_path):
    s = Store(str(tmp_path / "s.json"))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        create_task(s, {"title": "a", "priority": "urgent"})
    assert not s.tasks
    # nothing saved
    import os
    assert not os.path.exists(s.path)


def test_update_priority(tmp_path):
    s = Store(str(tmp_path / "s.json"))
    t = create_task(s, {"title": "a"})
    assert update_task(s, t["id"], {"priority": "high"})["priority"] == "high"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        update_task(s, t["id"], {"priority": "bogus"})
    # rejected update leaves the previous value
    assert s.tasks[t["id"]].priority == "high"


def test_priority_persisted_and_reloaded(tmp_path):
    p = str(tmp_path / "s.json")
    s = Store(p)
    create_task(s, {"title": "a", "priority": "low"})
    create_task(s, {"title": "b", "priority": "high"})
    s2 = Store(p)
    by_id = {t["id"]: t for t in list_tasks(s2)}
    assert by_id[1]["priority"] == "low"
    assert by_id[2]["priority"] == "high"


def test_old_store_without_priority_loads_as_normal(tmp_path):
    p = str(tmp_path / "s.json")
    with open(p, "w") as f:
        json.dump({"version": 1, "tasks": [{"id": 1, "title": "a", "done": False}]}, f)
    s = Store(p)
    assert list_tasks(s) == [{"id": 1, "title": "a", "done": False, "priority": "normal"}]


def test_filter_and_sort_by_priority(tmp_path):
    s = Store(str(tmp_path / "s.json"))
    create_task(s, {"title": "a"})          # 1 normal
    create_task(s, {"title": "b", "priority": "low"})   # 2 low
    create_task(s, {"title": "c", "priority": "high"})  # 3 high
    create_task(s, {"title": "d"})          # 4 normal
    create_task(s, {"title": "e", "priority": "high"})  # 5 high

    assert [t["id"] for t in list_tasks(s, priority="high")] == [3, 5]
    assert [t["id"] for t in list_tasks(s, priority="low")] == [2]
    assert [t["id"] for t in list_tasks(s)] == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    assert [t["id"] for t in list_tasks(s, sort="priority")] == [3, 5, 1, 4, 2]
"}
